headline: Check Point PHP2Shell zero-day gives root; N-central zero-day hits patched servers; SilentAir intercepts SMS 2FA codes in telecoms

bullets.text: New: a campaign dubbed SilentAir hijacks Asian telecom networks to intercept SMS two-factor codes and spy on Taiwanese users. Accounts that rely on SMS codes in the region should be treated as exposed.

PHP2Shell (5 outlets): the Check Point zero-day CVE-2026-123039 is exploited for root access on gateways; attackers deploy a TSGA backdoor and wipe ESXi files. No fixed release version is on the board.
N-central (PoC, 6 outlets): the N-able '4EverAble2Shell' zero-day was exploited hours after a PoC; 21 servers infected, 19 on Hotfix 2, so patched servers are not safe. No CVE or fix is on the board.
MSPs (8 outlets): worm-like SCKit malware spreads through ScreenConnect support sessions, nearly 50 organizations report breaches, and ConnectWise has disabled third-party extensions.

Still active: SignDrop Windows CLFS zero-day gives SYSTEM (no fix on board); 4,800 GitHub accounts hijacked for cloud credentials; Apache httpd HTTP/2 RCE CVE-2026-119618 patched; Xen Orchestra flaws exploited; Gootloader, CastleRAT and StealC infrastructure disrupted.

KEV due today (11-13): Barracuda CVE-2026-116606 and CVE-2026-111560. Due 11-24: Cisco BroadWorks CVE-2026-20320, Outlook CVE-2026-124194, Chromium CVE-2026-125350. SITCON 3; last 7 days run 1.09x the 90-day average.

actions: Move admin and high-value accounts off SMS 2FA to app-based or hardware keys, starting with users in Taiwan and Asian telecom regions.
Check Point: check its advisory for a CVE-2026-123039 fix and apply it, limit gateway management to trusted networks, and hunt for TSGA backdoor indicators.
N-central: treat servers as exposed even on Hotfix 2; take consoles off the internet and hunt for new admin accounts and unexpected agent commands.
ScreenConnect: inventory instances and extensions, confirm third-party extensions are disabled, and hunt for SCKit spreading from support sessions.
Patch Barracuda ESG today (KEV deadline 11-13) and Apache httpd for CVE-2026-119618; review GitHub sign-ins, PATs and Actions secrets.
